اغلنثين (form IIIq)
# اِغْلَنْثَيْنَ (iḡlanṯayna) /iɣ.lan.θaj.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِغْلَنْثَى (iḡlanṯā)
# اِغْلَنْثِينَ (iḡlanṯīna) /iɣ.lan.θiː.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِغْلَنْثَى (iḡlanṯā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
